title: A head lock pin without a matching pack is invalid input; a bad base pin is only a base defect that drops the pack

assert.why: A.3.1.3, A.16.1(c): both locks pin acme 1.0.0 at H({v: shape.pack.v1, files: [[acme.shape, sha256 of its text]]}), which the supplied pack matches; nothing is owed
the shapes are identical and Core has no claims
A.3.1.4 ("a bad head pin is invalid"), A.10.1 (head packs), A.16.1(c): the head lock's digest differs from the supplied pack's
A.3.1.4 (packs covers every pin of either lock), A.16.1(c): the head pin acme 1.0.0 has no pack entry
A.3.1.4 ("a bad base pin a base defect"), A.6.4.1-2, A.16.1(c): the base drops acme leniently and never makes the verdict invalid; neither shape uses anything acme declares
A.6.4.1: shape errors apply to the head only
pack items are never loosening subjects [D18]; no claim reads acme's effect
